Get antibiotic prescribing by BNF class from OpenPrescribing

Source: R/openprescribing.R
get_op_antibiotics.Rd

A convenience wrapper around get_op_spending that retrieves one series per antibacterial class in BNF section 5.1 (see op_antibiotic_classes) at the spatial resolution you choose.

Usage

get_op_antibiotics(classes = NULL, include_total = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

classes

which classes to fetch: NULL (default) for all thirteen sub-sections 5.1.1-5.1.13, or a character vector of section numbers ("5.1.5"), BNF codes ("050105") or class names ("Macrolides", case-insensitive).

include_total

logical. Also fetch all of section 5.1 as a further series (code "0501"). It overlaps the classes, so do not sum it with them.

...

passed to get_op_spending: resolution, org, date, start, end, add_list_size, as_data_table, verbose.

Value

As get_op_spending, with the class name in code_label. Costs one request per class (13 by default).

See also

op_antibiotic_classes

Examples

# \donttest{
# Macrolide and tetracycline items per 1,000 patients, by ICB, since 2023
get_op_antibiotics(c("5.1.3", "Macrolides"), resolution = "icb",
                   start = "2023-01", add_list_size = TRUE)
#> Error: OpenPrescribing refused the request (HTTP 403, a bot-protection challenge), so no data could be retrieved from /spending_by_org/.
#> This is applied by the service to some networks and clients (for example some cloud or institutional IP ranges). Try again later or from another network, and consider reducing the request rate with options(ukhsadatR.requests_per_second = 0.5).
# }
